heading: About
mainTitle: A small collection of writing — on code, craft, and culture.
intro: I'm **Jérémie Corpinot** — the sole developer and writer of this site. I build the platform and write the posts, focusing on technical depth and cultural perspective.
description: This space is intentionally small — fewer, better pieces. Expect practical guides, essays, and recommendations that bridge engineering and the arts.
openSourceText: The full source code is available on **GitHub**. Issues, PRs, or design suggestions are welcome — see the repository for contribution guidelines.
faqWhoContent: I do — I'm the sole developer and writer: Jérémie Corpinot. I handle code, publishing, and site design.
faqTopicsLabel: What topics do you write about?
faqTopicsContent: Mostly technology, development and programming. I also write about art and culture — films, books, and podcasts that influence my thinking.
faqOpenSourceContent: Yes — the project is open source on GitHub: github.com/rootasjey/corpinot
faqContributeLabel: Can I contribute or pitch a post?
faqContributeContent: Yes. Open a GitHub issue or send a short pitch to hello@corpinot.cc. I'm particularly interested in practical, experience-driven pieces.
faqNewsletterContent: Yes — subscribe for weekly highlights and occasional deep dives.
metaDescription: About Jérémie Corpinot — developer, writer, and creator of Corpinot.
contactText: Questions, pitches, or bugs? Email hello@corpinot.cc
